key_components.name: NavigationHeader
key_components.description: Sticky dark glassmorphism navbar with himawari24 branding, quick stats, active provider badges, and Admin authentication status.

key_components.name: MailboxList
key_components.description: Grid / Table of connected Microsoft Outlook / Hotmail mailboxes showing OAuth token status, email, scopes, last synced time, and Connect/Disconnect triggers.

key_components.name: ConnectOutlookOAuthModal
key_components.description: Interactive dialog / OAuth trigger card with step-by-step guidance for authenticating personal Microsoft/Outlook accounts via Microsoft Graph API.

key_components.name: EmailAssignmentsTable
key_components.description: Management panel mapping target Netflix recipient email addresses to their provider (gmail_imap vs outlook_graph). Allows inline switching and quick testing.

key_components.name: CategoryCodeSearch
key_components.description: High-priority search panel allowing selection of Netflix email address + category filter (Login Code, Verification Code, Household, Password Reset, TV Login). Displays instantaneous parsed results.

key_components.name: ParsedResultCard
key_components.description: Hero display card showing the extracted code/link with click-to-copy, expiration counter, raw snippet preview, and provider provenance metadata.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all frontend components reside in standard React .js format with Tailwind CSS classes.
Implement Microsoft OAuth flow simulation / API connection endpoints for backend `/api/auth/microsoft` and `/api/mailboxes` so administrators can connect, view, and refresh personal Outlook tokens.
Maintain backward compatibility with existing IMAP / Gmail fetching while prioritizing direct Microsoft Graph search when mapped provider is `outlook_graph`.
Provide clear alert prompts and visual badge states for connected vs needs_reconnect Outlook mailboxes.
Add interactive copy-to-clipboard buttons with toast feedback (sonner) when clicking on extracted Netflix login codes or verification links.
Strictly follow the dark high-density dashboard UI guidelines with zero white text collision and high contrast APCA compliance.
